title: NR7 Range vs ATR
summary: Among NR7 sessions: the narrowest range of the trailing seven, a flag the session earns itself: how often that same session's range still reached at least r times the prior 14-session ATR. Flag and measurement land on the same session, so this quantifies how deep NR7 compression runs against the longer volatility yardstick; the attached range-vs-ATR distribution is the fuller picture. It does not measure what happened the day after an NR7: that question needs a next-session range outcome, which this preset does not pretend to have.

params.name: r
params.doc: Range threshold in multiples of the prior 14-session ATR.

deltas: the full range-vs-ATR distribution of NR7 sessions, not just a threshold rate
r is a parameter, so 'compressed' is your definition rather than a preset author's
N + 95% CI + per-year counts on every number
